need: Read a per-task latency gate from the arm's pooled p95 where that alone decides it: a pooled p95 over the budget proves at least one task's p95 is over it too
why: The p95 budget is declared in each task but latency was recorded only over all tasks, so options_dominance, gate_matrix and decision_sensitivity read every place as no_figure and every arm fails alike; the two arms that clear pass rate everywhere actually fail latency for certain, which no tool says
workaround: State the deduction in words in the recommendation and lede; cite the pooled p95 keys; flag the missing per-task figures

need: An interval (or a count to read one from) on each arm's pass rate within each task

workaround: Cite each option's cost_per_month key side by side; no per-point price is stated
